Americans agree that lawmakers should not profit off their positions. That’s why my Stop Insider Trading Act is commonsense. It would prevent congressional insider trading.
 
Last week, the House of Representatives passed this bill with bipartisan support. Tonight, @SenAshleyMoody asked our Senate colleagues to unanimously pass this ban on insider trading. Senate Democrats objected.
 
I will continue fighting to get this bill signed into law.

posts.text:
This morning, I joined @SquawkCNBC to discuss my Stop Insider Trading Act.

My bill would prevent Members of Congress from buying new stocks once elected.  It would also require Members to notify the public of any sales of stocks they already own.

The House passed this commonsense legislation last night.  I am working with my Senate colleagues to get the Stop Insider Trading Act passed into law.
posts.summary: Advocates stock trading restrictions for Members of Congress
